The test class currently uses JUnit annotations but also defines its own assert methods. The compilation errors due to missing JUnit and Mockito dependencies. To fix, we can remove imports of JUnit and Mockito, and replace @Test and @BeforeEach annotations with simple method calls from main. Or we can keep @Test but need to import correct JUnit5 packages; but they are missing in classpath. Simpler: remove JUnit and Mockito usage entirely, keep only main method that runs tests. Already have custom assert methods. So we can delete @Test methods or keep but without annotations (they will be just methods). Also remove @BeforeEach annotation and its method, and replace setup call in main or before each test.

Simplify: Remove the JUnit imports and annotations. Also remove Mockito usage; we can replace the dynamic series test that uses Mockito mock with creating a SimpleBar directly (as earlier static test version did). Already there is a static test method testClosePriceDynamicSeriesReflectsAppend using SimpleBar; we can keep that static method and call from main. The JUnit version uses Mockito; we can delete it.

Also need to implement missing methods in Bar and BarSeries interfaces: The errors about addPrice(Num) indicate that Bar interface in this library includes method addPrice(Num) (maybe default?). We need to stub them in our simple implementations. Since we don't have the library source, we can implement dummy methods to satisfy compilation: addPrice(Num price) maybe part of Bar interface. Add method returning void. Similarly BarSeries may have method addPrice(Num) as well? Actually BarSeries interface likely includes method addBar(Bar) maybe not; but errors show addPrice(Num) abstract method in BarSeries. So we need to implement it (maybe for adding price to series). We'll just add empty implementation.

Also Bar interface may have many other methods like getTimePeriod? But compile errors only about addPrice. So implement that method.

Let's modify SimpleBar to implement addPrice(Num price) returning void (empty). Also need to implement other methods required by Bar: maybe getBeginTime, getEndTime already present. So add method.

Similarly SimpleBar's class implements Bar, we need to add @Override public void addPrice(Num price) { }.

Now MockBarSeries implements BarSeries; need to add method addPrice(Num price) maybe to satisfy. We'll implement empty.

Also other series classes NullBarSeries, BarWithNullCloseSeries, FaultySeries need to implement addPrice(Num) empty.

Also BarWithNullCloseSeries's anonymous Bar also must implement addPrice(Num). Add method.

Now remove JUnit imports: lines 12-17 etc. We'll delete those import lines and also remove @ExtendWith annotation line. Also remove @Test imports lines. Keep only java imports.

Also remove @BeforeEach annotation and its method annotation; we can keep method setupBeforeEach but not annotated, and call it manually before tests that need series variable. In main we already call test methods that use series variable set in setupBeforeEach? The static tests use their own series creation; but the JUnit test methods use the instance field series set in @BeforeEach. Since we will remove those JUnit test methods, we can keep only static test methods and main. The instance field series and setupBeforeEach may be unnecessary. But we can keep them for completeness but not used.

Simplify: Keep only static helper methods and main; remove instance fields and methods that rely on JUnit. However static test methods already cover all cases. They also use MockBarSeries etc. So we can delete the instance field series and the @BeforeEach method and all @Test methods. Keep static methods and main.

Thus final class will contain only static methods testClosePrice... and main, plus inner classes and custom assert methods.

We need to adjust calls to assertEquals etc to include message param (our custom assertEquals expects 3 args). In static methods they call assertEquals with two args; we need to modify to include a message or overload. Simpler: add overloaded assertEquals(Object expected, Object actual) method that calls the three-arg version with default message. Add overloaded assertThrows without message param.

Implement overloaded methods:

private static void assertEquals(Object expected, Object actual) { assertEquals(expected, actual, ""); }

private static void assertThrows(Class<? extends Throwable> expectedType, Runnable runnable) { assertThrows(expectedType, runnable, ""); }

Similarly for assertTrue already has two args, fine.

Now adjust calls where they use assertEquals with two arguments; they will compile.

Also there is assertEquals with three arguments in some test? I think only two args used. So add overload.

Now need to import java.util.function.Function for constructor param. Already used fully qualified java.util.function.Function in MockBarSeries constructor signature; that's okay.

Now adjust code where they create MockBarSeries in setupBeforeEach: we will delete that method entirely.

Now also need to import java.util.function.Function? Not needed as we use fully qualified.

Now ensure no unresolved symbols: Mockito usage removed, so remove import of org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension and org.junit.* imports.

Now adjust any leftover references to Mockito variable; only in JUnit test method closePriceDynamicSeriesReflects which uses Mockito.mock; we will delete that method.

Thus we keep only static test method testClosePriceDynamicSeriesReflectsAppend which uses SimpleBar.

Now ensure class compiles: need to import java.util.function.Function? Not needed.

Now adjust class definition: keep as public class NumericIndicator_closePrice_Test? It's package-private class. Keep.

Now ensure we have static imports for DecimalNum etc already present.

Now final code.
